children: ChargePoint Holdings, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $116.08M, an improvement from $98.59M a year earlier, while the company narrowed its loss to ($35.62M) and reported diluted loss per share of ($1.35) versus ($2.85) in the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “loss per share - Basic and Diluted (1)”.
Networked Charging Systems revenue rose about 24.8% sequentially and 13.4% year-to-date, driven by higher unit deliveries across major product families.
Subscriptions expanded roughly 9.5% quarter-over-quarter and 8.4% year-to-date, increasing recurring revenue to about 38% of total YTD revenue.
Gross margin improved by roughly 5.2 percentage points sequentially and 3.1 points year-to-date, aided by cost efficiencies and a one-time tariff refund.
Headcount reductions and reorganizations in R&D, sales and G&A reduced operating expenses despite severance and exit costs.
Assure and CPaaS subscription growth and higher transaction fee volumes supported platform monetization and driver/site services.
